The O <3D> STAGGERmean3D departure deck: 4326 aux rows, 21-value A(O) axis (7.6-9.6), ndep=101, nlev=41 -- matching atom.o41f's 41 levels. VERIFIED by direct read at the solar node t5777g44m00: all finite, no all-zero rows, median b -> 1.0000 at depth (the LTE limit) and 0.9950 at tau~1. tau agreement with the <3D> atmosphere is 2.45e-08 -- effectively exact. Registered here so the deck does NOT read as 'never fetched': the element status tracker reads the REGISTRATION, not the disk (the RYA-785 lesson).
